top_signals.title: Can Scotland’s Abundant Wind Power a Data Center Boom?
top_signals.summary: Scotland produces far more wind power than its grid can handle, forcing turbines to be shut down when supply exceeds demand or transmission capacity. Developers now see a possible solution: build data centers close to the surplus power, turning wasted wind into compute capacity for AI and the digital economy.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: LDP-backed Genta Koja wins Okinawa gubernatorial election
top_signals.summary: Media reports, including by NHK, citing exit polls said Koja had bested incumbent Gov. Denny Tamaki, who had been vying for a third term.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
